verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows that Workers keeps service-to-service traffic on a private path off the public internet. The Bindings claim [cloudflare-docs-10] only covers connecting to databases, APIs and storage, and the Zero Trust controls in [cloudflare-docs-18] are a related network-security feature, not private internal routing. The Think harness's sub-agent RPC is agent orchestration and says nothing about network isolation, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity
